findings: missing requirement attack matrix and risk saturation

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery can appear healthy from CI or happy-path tests while its handoff omits deterministic completeness evidence, allowing an independent audit to become the first mechanism that discovers missing specification coverage or unsaturated controls.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Declare a candidate ready after successful build and tests, but do not prove that every canonical obligation maps to a requirement attack, every applicable risk family is saturated, and every inherited control was re-executed on the material candidate.

reusable_control.procedure: Before independent audit expenditure, require a tamper-evident certificate over complete specification coverage, requirement attacks, risk saturation, inherited controls, escape closure and generalized learning; reject any stale or uncertified result-only evidence commit.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: The delivery controller must fail closed before handoff unless canonical source coverage is complete and all mandatory readiness artifacts are valid for the material candidate.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: The independent auditor must run a cheap certificate/readiness preflight before broad discovery and reject missing, stale, path-contaminated or incomplete evidence packets.

transfer_cases.scenario: A synthetic specification contains two material obligations while the closure maps only one.
transfer_cases.expected: The delivery coverage gate rejects before handoff.

transfer_cases.scenario: A synthetic material candidate is followed by a result-only child whose changed paths differ from the certificate policy.
transfer_cases.expected: The audit preflight rejects before broad audit.
transfer_cases.evidence: generic handoff certificate and certified-delivery preflight tests

skill_changes.evidence: handoff certificate contract supports complete certified result-only evidence bundle; focused suite 4 passed
certified delivery preflight validates exact allowed paths and material candidate identity; focused suite 4 passed
